Community Development Commission
AGENDA
la puente Community Development Commission
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
November 27, 2007
07:00 PM
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL MEMBERS: Chavez, Lujan, Solis, Storing, Perez
COMMISSIONERS: Chavez, Lujan, Solis, Storing, Perez
AUTHORITY MEMBERS: Chavez, Lujan, Solis, Storing, Perez
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
RECOGNITION OF CO-SPONSORS OF THE 16TH ANNUAL MAIN STREET HALLOWEEN RUN
RECOGNITION OF GRAND PRIZE WINNERS FROM THE HALLOWEEN FESTIVAL PHONE HOME PROGRAM
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council, or Community Development Commission on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETINGS OF NOVEMBER 14, 2006, NOVEMBER 28, 2006, JUNE 12, 2007, JUNE 26, 2007, JULY 24, 2007, AND AUGUST 14, 2007, AND THE SPECIAL MEETINGS OF MARCH 22, 2007, JUNE 27, 2007, SEPTEMBER 11, 2007, AND NOVEMBER 11, 2007
It is recommended that the City Council waive the reading and approve the minutes of the Regular Meetings of November 14, 2006, November 28, 2006, June 12, 2007, June 26, 2007, July 24, 2007, and August 14, 2007, and the Special Meetings of March 22, 2007, June 27, 2007, September 11, 2007, and November 11, 2007.
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF LOAN AGREEMENT WITH UNION BANK OF CALIFORNIA FOR THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER AND THE LA PUENTE YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
None.
CITY COUNCIL CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
APPROVAL OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1215 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution.
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FOR FISCAL YEAR 2006-2007 AND FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF NEW PARTICIPANT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM FUNDED BY REPAID LOAN REUSE ACCOUNT
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Assistant City Manager to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $10,000.
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF PROGRAM SUMMARY MONTHLY (PSM) REPORT FOR CALHOME HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM REUSE ACCOUNT AND ROUND 2
It is recommended that the City Council approve the agenda report of the City Manager and authorize that it be filed for audit.
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF NEW PARTICIPANT FOR CDBG HOUSING REHABILITATION PROGRAM (D97301-08) - FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008
It is recommended that the City Council approve the allocations and authorize the Assistant City Manager to execute the necessary documents to implement the Housing Rehabilitation Program in the amount of $7,000.
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF BID FOR PURCHASE OF A 2008 FORD ESCAPE HYBRID FWD FOR THE PUBLIC WORKS DIRECTOR
It is recommended that the City Council award the purchase of a new 2008 Ford Escape Hybrid FWD to Burch Ford at a cost of $25,550.45.
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZING THE MAYOR TO SEND A LETTER OF SUPPORT TO GOVERNOR SCHWARZENEGGER AND STATE LEGISLATORS TO RESTORE THE $14 MILLION IN PUBLIC LIBRARY FUNDING
It is recommended that the City Council authorize the Mayor to send a letter of support to Governor Schwarzenegger and State legislators to restore funding to the public library system.
D-8
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A RESOLUTION IMPLEMENTING A FIVE YEARS OF SERVICE REQUIREMENT FOR RETIREE ELIGIBILITY OF CONTINUED HEALTH CARE BENEFITS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution implementing a five year vesting requirement with the City of La Puente for retiree health care benefits.
D-9
CONSIDERATION OF LEGAL SERVICES AGREEMENT WITH JONES HALL FOR PROVIDING TAX OPINIONS ON THE FINANCING STRUCTURE FOR THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER AND THE LA PUENTE YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) review the legal services agreement with Jones Hall for obtaining a loan for the Community Center and Youth Learning Activity Center Project; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the legal services agreement.
D-10
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ESCROW SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council award the contract to Rehab Financial Corporation and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement with Rehab Financial Corporation for escrow services for all Housing Rehabilitation loan accounts.
D-11
CONSIDERATION OF AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008 BUDGET TO INCLUDE THE REPAYMENT OF ADVANCES FROM THE GENERAL FUND TO THE SEWER FUND
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the resolution approving the repayment of advances in the amount of $271,432.96 from the Sewer Construction / Maintenance Fund to the General Fund as funding is available in the Sewer Construction / Maintenance Fund.
D-12
CONSIDERATION OF A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS TO PUBLISH THE SPOTLIGHT LA PUENTE COMMUNITY NEWSPAPER
It is recommended that the City Council authorize staff to release a Request for Proposals to publish the Spotlight La Puente Community Newspaper.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF QUARTERLY CRIME REPORT PRESENTED BY CAPTAIN MICHAEL SMITH, INDUSTRY STATION
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the report as presented.
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING AND CONVENE THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION MEETING
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF REVISED LEASE AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT WITH ED BUTTS FORD, INC. FOR PROPOSED EXPANSION AT 1529-1545 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD
RECESS THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AND RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING.
E-3
CONSIDERATION OF AUTHORIZATION TO INCREASE GRANT AMOUNT AVAILABLE FOR LEAD AND ASBESTOS TESTING AND ABATEMENT SERVICES
It is recommended that the City Council authorize an increase in the grant amount for lead and asbestos testing and abatement services to $5,000.00 per residence.
E-4
CONSIDERATION OF CLOSING CITY HALL AND THE MAINTENANCE YARD ALL DAY CHRISTMAS EVE (DECEMBER 24, 2007)
None.
E-5
CONSIDERATION OF NEW COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT (CDBG) PROGRAM PROJECTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008
It is recommended that the City Council direct staff to initiate the public notice process and schedule a public hearing to consider the re-programming of CDBG funds currently reserved for the Ed Butts Ford Expansion Project to the re-roofing of the Senior Center, the expansion of the handicapped sidewalk project, and the partial funding of Community Preservation activities in predominantly low and moderate income census blocks.
E-6
CONSIDERATION OF ADOPTING A CODE OF CONDUCT FOR ALL CITY OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the Code of Conduct.
E-9
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF LA PUENTE REVISING ITS POLICY REGARDING THE REIMBURSEMENT OF EXPENSES FOR CITY COUNCIL MEMBERS, MEMBERS OF BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS, AND CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached resolution, which revises La Puente's expense and reimbursement policy, and directs all of the City's elected officials, as well as all City board, committee and commission members to immediately comply with the requirements of this revised policy.
E-7
CONSIDERATION OF 2007 SAFE ROUTES TO SCHOOL GRANT PROGRAM
It is recommended that the City Council support the submission of the 2007 Safe Routes to School Program Application for Nelson Elementary School, Del Valle Elementary School, Workman Elementary School and Hurley Elementary School.
E-8
CONSIDERATION OF A PROPOSAL FROM THE LA PUENTE YOUTH COALITION FOR THE USE OF LA PUENTE PARK FOR A COMMUNITY CARNIVAL AND WAIVER OF FEES
It is recommended that the City Council approve the use of La Puente Park for the La Puente Youth Coalition Carnival, waive City fees, set the security deposit at $1,000, and require the Coalition to provide twelve (12) portable restrooms.
COUNCIL AB1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING OF JULY 24, 2007, AND THE SPECIAL MEETINGS OF AUGUST 14, 2007, OCTOBER 23, 2007, AND NOVEMBER 11, 2007
It is recommended that the Community Development Commission waive the reading and approve the minutes of the Regular Meeting of July 24, 2007, and the Special Meetings of August 14, 2007, October 23, 2007, and November 11, 2007.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
B-1
CONTINUED PUBLIC HEARING - CONSIDERATION OF REVISED LEASE AND DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT WITH ED BUTTS FORD, INC. FOR PROPOSED EXPANSION AT 1529-1545 N. HACIENDA BOULEVARD
UNFINISHED BUSINESS
None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Commission, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of Commission. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER CDC NO. 101 FOR FISCAL YEAR 2007-2008
It is recommended that the Commission adopt the resolution.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION
None.
ADJOURN THE COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT COMMISSION AND CONVENE THE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the Public Financing Authority on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the Authority Secretary no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843).
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETINGS OF OCTOBER 23, 2007 AND NOVEMBER 11, 2007
It is recommended that the Public Financing Authority waive the reading and approve the minutes of the Special Meetings of October 23, 2007 and November 11, 2007.
October 23, 2007
November 11, 2007
PUBLIC HEARINGS
None.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
None.
CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the Authority, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the Authority. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
None.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A LEASE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY FOR THE LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER AND THE LA PUENTE YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER
It is recommended that the Public Financing Authority: (1) review the lease agreement between the City of La Puente and Public Financing Authority, Assignment of Lease and resolution for the Community Center and Youth Learning Activity Center Project; and (2) authorize the Chairman to execute the lease financing documents.
Lease Agreement Rpt.
ADJOURNMENT
Copies of reports relating to items on the Agenda are available for public inspection or purchase at City Hall. Questions regarding agenda items may be addressed to the City Clerk at 626/855-1500, extension 503. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk’s Office. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 p.m. time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury, under the laws of the State of California, that the foregoing agenda was posted in accordance with the applicable legal requirements. Dated this 20th day of November, 2007.
_______________________
Jessica Duban, City Clerk
